Uses only synthetic data, with no live government system.

sections.name: File setup, hero
sections.title: Imports and shared hero search values
sections.what: Brings in the test tools and the official record functions, resets the database after each test, and defines the hero search values used by the checks.
sections.why: Likely reason: one shared hero input keeps the search checks consistent.

sections.name: synthetic official record provider
sections.title: Search results, input checks and identity matching
sections.what: Checks that the hero search returns exactly one synthetic, non-authoritative record, the control returns one, the ambiguous search returns two and an unknown search returns none. Also checks that incomplete or wrongly typed queries are rejected and that identity matching gives exact, partial or mismatch.
sections.why: Likely reason: search is how a case links to a record, so it must not guess.
sections.watch_out: The length limit on search fields is not covered by these checks.

sections.name: synthetic official record import
sections.title: Repeat-safe import
sections.what: Clears the hero and control import rows, imports the hero twice and the control once, and checks the first import is new while the repeat is marked as already imported. It also checks there is one row per case and reads the parcel geometry and verification before importing; the rest of that comparison is cut off in the packet.
sections.why: Likely reason: a repeated click or request must not create duplicate records.
sections.watch_out: The test depends on the import reporting the already-imported flag correctly, so callers must read that flag.

summary: Tests the synthetic official record search, input checks, identity matching and repeat-safe import.
purpose: Confirms search returns only the expected fixtures, rejects bad input, labels identity match clearly and does not duplicate records on repeat imports.
why: Likely reason: official-style lookups are sensitive, so bad input must be refused and matches must be explicit.
how: Section one imports the code and sets the shared hero search values, resetting the database after each test. Section two checks search results for the hero, control, ambiguous and unknown cases, rejects incomplete or wrongly typed queries, and checks exact, partial and mismatch identity results. Section three imports the hero and control twice and checks there is still one row per case.
inputs: Sample search values and the synthetic record identifiers.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: The import test deletes rows for the two demo cases from storage.
debug: If search counts differ, compare with the fixture list in the official record service. If identity results differ, check the rules in the identity match function.
